slices.behaviour: The kill check reads a slice as the floor does: a killed mutant counts when it sits in a file the slice names or in the source mutation.source_files maps a named test to, so a slice naming only packages/core/src/fee.test.ts accepts a killed-mutant RED in fee.ts (F1 of the attempt 8 review); and a change to packages/core/tsconfig.json makes mutation_ci.select choose all of src, as the other configuration files do (F2).
slices.failure_reason: test_a_kill_in_the_source_of_the_test_a_slice_names_is_a_red: HarnessError: Check 3 exited 0 and is cited as a RED because its Stryker report killed a mutant, but every mutant it killed is in a file the slice does not name: killed in packages/core/src/fee.ts, the slice names packages/core/src/fee.test.ts; test_a_changed_tsconfig_selects_all_of_src: AssertionError: None != 'src/**/*.ts,!src/**/*.test.ts'
